svg.text: #668 High-Density AI Data Center Power Transients (di/dt), BESS Smoothing & DLC Retrofit Sizer
Taming 75% 15ms GPU Step-Load Swings (11.5% with 48V Supercap + BESS) & Sizing RDHx (45kW) vs. L2A (75kW) vs. L2L (140kW)
Why AI Clusters Trip Legacy UPS & Diesel Generators (di/dt)
• Synchronous Barrier / AllReduce / Prefill Wave across 128–1,024 GPUs:
Every GPU drops to 25% TDP during network barrier/checkpoint, then jumps
to 100%–118% peak TDP simultaneously within 5–20 milliseconds!
• Unmitigated Step-Load Swing: ΔP = 75.0% of cluster peak in <20 ms
(Exceeds ISO-8528 G3 diesel generator 50% step limit -> frequency collapse!).
• Trap of Naive Static Power Capping (`nvidia-smi -pl 490W` = 70% TDP):
Still leaves a 42% step swing while destroying 19.4% GEMM/Prefill throughput!
3-Layer Power Smoothing Architecture (11.5% Net Swing):
1. Sub-100ms: ORv3 48V DC Bus Supercapacitor / CBU Shelf absorbs micro-spikes
2. 100ms–15s: UPS Li-Ion BESS Peak-Shaving Mode ramps utility load at <10%/s
3. Software: Dummy FP16 burn loop holds 45% floor during long collective stalls
Colocation Cooling Retrofit vs. Greenfield DLC Decision Matrix
• Tier 1: Legacy Air CRAC (<= 15 kW/rack · PUE 1.48)
Only fits 2–4× L40S or PCIe H100; 8-GPU HGX (10.2–14 kW/node) overheats.
• Tier 2: Rear-Door Heat Exchanger RDHx (<= 45 kW/rack · PUE 1.26)
100% heat neutral to room air; fits 3× air-cooled HGX H200 per rack.
• Tier 3: Liquid-to-Air (L2A) Sidecar CDU + Cold Plates (<= 75 kW/rack · PUE 1.22)
ZERO facility water pipes needed! Closed-loop cold plates reject heat to
existing hot aisle — fastest way to deploy 3–4× HGX H200/B200 in legacy DC!
Tier 4: Direct-to-Chip Liquid-to-Liquid (L2L) CDU (<= 140 kW/rack)
Mandatory for GB200 / GB300 NVL72 (120–140 kW/rack) & 8× HGX B200.
32°C–40°C warm-water supply enables compressor-free dry coolers (PUE 1.11).
Saves $1.42M/yr electricity per 1,000 GPUs vs. legacy PUE 1.48 air cooling!
Cloud & AI SA Golden Rule for High-Density AI Facilities:
Size PDUs and breakers to 1.25× peak excursion (not average TDP), use L2A Sidecar CDUs when facility water is unavailable, and mandate L2L for >80 kW/rack.
